note: Conceptual case-study lesson (Doverfield replicating Salesforce data into a warehouse) teaching full-extract vs incremental-extract vs Change Data Capture, framed around the real behavior that SystemModstamp-based incremental sync misses deletes while CDC's event stream includes delete/undelete events, and that the Bulk API is Salesforce's mechanism for isolating high-volume extraction from standard API traffic. No screenshots per this course's conceptual/architecture policy. CDC and Bulk API behavior reflect general, long-standing Salesforce platform documentation; no invented limit numbers are stated.
